title: Battlegrounds
content: 3.3.5 has six battlegrounds: Warsong Gulch (capture the flag, from level 10), Arathi Basin (five nodes, from 20), Alterac Valley (40 a side, from 51), Eye of the Storm (from 61), and Strand of the Ancients and Isle of Conquest (both from 71). Queue from a Battlemaster or the PvP window. Wintergrasp is a zone, not a battleground.

title: Arena Combat
content: Arena teams fight 2v2, 3v3 or 5v5 in Nagrand Arena, Blade's Edge Arena, the Ruins of Lordaeron, the Dalaran sewers and the Ring of Valor. Rated matches move your team rating, and Arena Points are paid out weekly by rating if you played at least 10 games that week; skirmishes are unrated practice.

title: World PvP
content: World PvP happens anywhere outside sanctuaries: classic hot spots are Tarren Mill against Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills and the Gurubashi Arena in Stranglethorn Vale, and Wintergrasp is Northrend's open-world PvP zone, where the attackers besiege the fortress with siege vehicles on a timer.

title: PvP Ranks and Titles
content: The old Vanilla system of 14 numbered PvP ranks was replaced when the honor system was overhauled in the Burning Crusade: honor points are now spent directly on gear instead of being ground through ranks. The prestigious 'Grand Marshal' (Alliance) and 'High Warlord' (Horde) titles still exist, but are now awarded to the single highest-rated arena player of each class and faction at the end of a PvP season, alongside seasonal Gladiator titles for the top-rated teams. Titles are prestigious and show PvP dedication.

title: PvP Gear Progression
content: PvP gear carries resilience, which lowers the chance to be crit and the damage taken from players. Entry pieces are bought with Honor, the season's best pieces need Arena Points, and the top items also require a personal arena rating. Honor caps at 75,000, so spend it before hitting the cap.

title: Faction Conflicts
content: The faction war flared at the Wrathgate in Dragonblight, where Grand Apothecary Putress unleashed a plague that killed both Bolvar Fordragon and Dranosh Saurfang. Varimathras seized the Undercity at the same time, and Thrall and King Varian Wrynn retook it together in the Battle for the Undercity.

title: Honor System
content: Honor comes from honorable kills, battleground wins and objectives, and Wintergrasp; a player low enough to show grey to you gives none. Honor doesn't decay and caps at 75,000, and it's spent with PvP vendors on gear.

title: Ganking and Ambush Tactics
content: Ganking is a much higher-level player killing a low-level one, common on PvP realms in contested zones like Stranglethorn Vale and Hillsbrad Foothills. It earns the ganker nothing, since a target low enough to show grey gives no honor. The usual answers are calling friends or a guard, or leaving the area.

title: Battleground Objectives
content: How each battleground is won: Warsong Gulch, capture the enemy flag three times; Arathi Basin, hold more of the five nodes to win the resource race; Alterac Valley, kill the enemy general, Drek'Thar or Vanndar; Eye of the Storm, hold towers and carry the center flag; Strand of the Ancients, reach the relic faster; Isle of Conquest, break the keep and kill its general.

title: PvP Rewards and Incentives
content: Beyond gear, PvP pays titles and mounts: each season's top arena teams earn the Gladiator title and that season's frost wyrm, the Deadly, Furious, Relentless and Wrathful Gladiator's Frost Wyrm in Wrath, and the For the Alliance and For the Horde achievements, killing the enemy faction's leaders, award a Black War Bear.
